components.name: BasisButton
components.summary: Primary interactive trigger executing actions on click or tap.
components.description: BasisButton represents an action the user can take. It supports visual hierarchy through variants, interactive feedback states, icons, and accessible touch target compliance.

parts.name: Container
parts.description: Root interactive container providing background fill, border, elevation, and shape.

parts.name: Leading Icon
parts.description: Optional decorative or identifying icon positioned before the label.

parts.name: Trailing Icon
parts.description: Optional accessory icon or disclosure indicator positioned after the label.

variants.name: Primary
variants.description: High-emphasis action for the primary task in a view.

variants.name: Secondary
variants.description: Medium-emphasis action for secondary or alternative workflows.

variants.name: Outline
variants.description: Bordered action with transparent background for balanced hierarchy.

variants.name: Ghost
variants.description: Subtle low-emphasis action with no container fill or border until interaction.

states.name: Enabled
states.description: Default interactive idle state ready for user input.

states.name: Pressed
states.description: Active pointer engagement with immediate visual feedback.

states.name: Focused
states.description: Keyboard or programmatic navigation focus with distinct focus ring.

states.name: Disabled
states.description: Non-interactive state with muted contrast indicating unavailable action.

signatures.name: BasisButton

parameters.name: onClick
parameters.description: Callback executed when user activates the button.

parameters.name: modifier
parameters.description: Modifier applied to the outer button container.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: Visual weight and styling configuration variant.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether the button responds to user interaction.

parameters.name: leadingIcon
parameters.description: Optional icon composable rendered before the label.

parameters.name: trailingIcon
parameters.description: Optional icon composable rendered after the label.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Slot for button content, typically a text label.

components.name: basisMinTouchTarget
components.summary: Enforces a minimum accessible touch target size on the modified element without altering visual size.
components.description: Enforces a minimum accessible touch target size on the modified element without altering visual size.  When [min] is unspecified ([Dp.Unspecified]), the minimum target dimension is driven by [ConstraintsControl.minTouchTarget] from the ambient theme via [BasisTheme.minTouchTarget], falling back to `48.dp` if no constraint was configured.

signatures.name: basisMinTouchTarget

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Minimum touch target dimension in [Dp], defaults to [Dp.Unspecified] to follow theme constraints.

signatures.kdoc:
/**
 * Enforces a minimum accessible touch target size on the modified element without altering visual size.
 *
 * When [min] is unspecified ([Dp.Unspecified]), the minimum target dimension is driven by
 * [ConstraintsControl.minTouchTarget] from the ambient theme via [BasisTheme.minTouchTarget],
 * falling back to `48.dp` if no constraint was configured.
 *
 * @param min Minimum touch target dimension in [Dp], defaults to [Dp.Unspecified] to follow theme constraints.
 * @return Configured [Modifier].
 */
